title: Debug double borrow bug in Rust — 3 turns
description: Code uses RefCell incorrectly causing borrow panics at runtime. Fix borrow order, run tests, refactor to eliminate RefCell.

task_spec.prompt: The `sum_and_double` method in `src/lib.rs` has a bug: it uses `vals.len() as i32` (count of elements) instead of the actual sum. Fix it to compute the correct sum using `vals.iter().sum()`. Run `cargo test --quiet`.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what you fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them. Also look at `SimpleContainer` — make sure `double_sum()` works correctly by calling `self.sum() * 2`.

Final step: refactor `sum_and_double` to drop the borrow before computing the result — use `let s = { self.values.borrow().iter().sum::<i32>() };` with a block to ensure the borrow is released immediately. Run `cargo test --quiet` — all 4 tests must pass.
success_criteria: Borrow is dropped before any subsequent operations
SimpleContainer sum and double_sum work correctly
